water.title: 💧 Water today
water.note:
Drinks from nutrition (coffee, juice, milk) are counted automatically.
Choose how much to add:
water.custom: Enter an amount, for example 0.4 (L) or 300 ml. To subtract a wrong entry, use a minus: -0.25.
water.parse_error: Couldn't recognise the amount. Enter from 0.05 to 5 L, for example 0.5 or 250 ml.
weight.title: ⚖️ Weight
weight.prompt: Enter your new weight in kg, for example 74.5.
weight.invalid: Enter a weight from 20 to 400 kg, for example 74.5.
